title: A Court of Frost and Starlight
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: A short novella set in the weeks around a midwinter festival, shortly after a great war. The series' characters rest, rebuild and look after each other.
readIf: you want a soft, low-stakes visit with the characters of an existing series.
skipIf: you want action or plot, since this one is quiet and aimed at readers already invested in the series.

pairings.reason: The war-heavy book that comes right before this novella and the story it follows on from.
A cosy fantasy about rest and community, with no romance-heavy politics at all.
Another warm story about a found family finding a place to belong.
